mapper.sql: SELECT account_id, company_id, account_code, account_name, account_type, dept_id, bank_name, bank_branch, account_number_encrypt, account_tail, currency, opening_balance, current_balance, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_bank_account
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bank_account SET current_balance = current_balance + #{delta}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_cash_flow ( flow_no, account_id, flow_date, period, dept_id, direction, biz_type, amount, balance_after, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, voucher_id, reconcile_status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{flowNo}, #{accountId}, #{flowDate}, #{period}, #{deptId}, #{direction}, #{bizType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceKey}, #{voucherId}, #{reconcileStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT f.account_id, (SELECT account_name FROM fin_bank_account a WHERE a.account_id = f.account_id) AS accountName, SUM(CASE WHEN f.direction = 'IN' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END) AS inAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.direction = 'OUT' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.direction = 'IN' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END) AS netAmount, COUNT(*) AS flowCount FROM fin_cash_flow f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.flow_date = #{date} GROUP BY f.account_id ORDER BY netAmount DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS netAmount, COUNT(*) AS flowCount FROM fin_cash_flow WHERE period = #{period} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_cash_flow SET reconcile_status = '1', update_time = sysdate() WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} AND del_flag = '0' AND reconcile_status != '1'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_cash_flow WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_flag = '0'
